newsitem.title: BULGARIA: ONLY TREASURY PAPER TRADES ON BULGARIA BOURSES.
newsitem.headline: ONLY TREASURY PAPER TRADES ON BULGARIA BOURSES.

text.p: The RABSI (Reuter All Bulgaria Stock Index) was unchanged from Tuesday's 41.28 points as no corporate issues traded on Bulgarian bourses for a third day in row, brokers said.
Three seven-day repo deals in treasury paper worth of 3.620 million levs were struck on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange (BSE).
The paper yields 4.90-4.95 percent until repurchase.
No repo deals were struck on Bulgarian bourses on Tuesday.
Hebrosbank shares were offered at 800 levs against 1,000 par on the BSE and Razvitie Investment Fund third issue stocks were asked at 35 levs, below par of 100, but there were no bidders.
Only Varna Grand Hotel was bid at 85 levs against par of 100, but there were no shares on offer, said traders. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
